{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove QA orders with '999999.99'
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()

# Clean all revenue values: remove commas and cast to float
# This includes real values with thousands separators
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify
print(f"First 5 revenue values after cleaning:")
print(df_clean['revenue'].head(5))

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"\nStatus distribution:")
print(df_clean['status'].value_counts())

# Check for customer_age sentinel -1
print(f"\nCustomer age -1 count: {df_clean['customer_age'].eq(-1).sum()}")

# Replace -1 with NaN
df_clean['customer_age'] = df_clean['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Check the data
print(f"\nFinal dataset shape: {df_clean.shape}")
print(f"\nColumns: {list(df_clean.columns)}")
print(f"\nDtypes:\n{df_clean.dtypes}")"}
